title: Reading strategy
summary: Read the definition before the example, then verify the claim against r13196.
steps: quote the exact token or message
search the language reference before examples
if a dot message or collection method is involved, switch to class reference
if a file/package/launcher is involved, switch to runtime reference
note whether text is normative, explanatory or illustrative
test the smallest case with the exact interpreter/compiler
misreadings: an example is not automatically a grammar rule
a project helper is not a built-in class
a successful parse does not prove runtime semantics
